request.notes: One optional argument, `prefix` (str | None, default None). Without it the tool answers every tag in the corpus (/knowledge/tags sends no arguments and filters Lens-side, because its family facet is derived from the whole set). With it, only tags whose lowercased name starts with the lowercased prefix are returned (case-INSENSITIVE startswith; the keys keep their stored case). The landing's "Filtered by <tag>" count sends the active tag as `prefix` and reads the EXACT key back — a prefix match also returns longer tags (`project:influx-old`).

observed_divergences: The tool documents no error envelope: it returns {"tags": {tag: document_count}} from the in-memory corpus index (CorpusIndex.all_tags — one count per cached document carrying the tag), {} when nothing matches. A failure reaches Lens only as a transport/MCP error, which the client raises as a coded LithosToolError like any other tool.
